notes.title: Nigredo - Patch v0.1.4 Released
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45613574/06c30e4e06c01ce9589b7480c4a9da0516566715.png"]With Steam Next Fest over, we received a lot of valuable feedback!

We sincerely thank everyone who took the time to play the demo and especially those who went the extra mile to share their impressions with us.

One recurring comment was the lack of a tutorial or help panel. In response, we’ve added a new in-game window that clearly explains the meaning of each icon and what they represent on the screen.

Thank you for your continued support. We humbly ask for even more feedback it’s essential for making Nigredo better and better!



Also, follow us on twitter. We try to update daily what we're working on our projects.



— Team Pingado

notes.title: Nigredo - Patch v0.1.3 Released
notes.notes:
Nigredo - Patch v0.1.3 Released



🔧 What's New:

Game Speed Setters: You can now directly set the game speed using number keys and the space key.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45613574/1bebf5f3830c5bf0786655b3248496ba1b0dce67.jpg

Keyboard Camera Controls: Navigate the environment with WASD.

Auto Save: Creates a save file called AutoSave every new day.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45613574/3eee8189d6e5efba02d5901b647e052d4426fbe1.jpg

These changes are part of our ongoing effort to tighten the game loop and improve accessibility. As always, your feedback helps shape Nigredo. More to come.

— Team Pingado
